rss: £170 a bag? Protein users squeezed as prices soar
title: Candy Costs Climb Sky High
story: The price of candy has gone way up! Now, it costs much more to buy your favorite sweets at the store.
storyBig: The candy market is experiencing a significant price increase, affecting consumers who now have to pay more for their favorite treats. This can impact how families budget their spending on such items.
think: Why do you think prices sometimes go up for things we like?
bull: Candy makers might earn more money with higher prices.
bear: People might buy less candy because it costs more.

rss: How the oil capital of the US welcomed a solar power boom
title: Sunny Days for Solar Power
story: A sunny place is now using more sunlight to make electricity than ever! Solar power is growing really fast there.
storyBig: A region known for its oil production is now leading in solar energy, highlighting a shift towards renewable sources. This change shows how different regions can adapt to new energy trends.
think: Can you think of other ways to get energy besides oil and sunlight?
bull: Solar power is clean and helps the environment.
bear: Switching to solar might be expensive at first.
